local_literature_search.interpretation: The scoped search did not establish FR-SHADE as a uniquely published standard algorithm name. This is absence of confirming evidence, not proof that no publication anywhere uses the string.

primary_external_evidence.title: Success-History Based Parameter Adaptation for Differential Evolution
Evaluating the performance of SHADE on CEC 2013 benchmark problems
observed_contract: M_CR and M_F initialize at 0.5 and are sampled through normal and Cauchy distributions respectively
current-to-pbest/1 mutation, binomial crossover, midpoint bounds correction and an external archive are part of SHADE
the paper uses weighted arithmetic mean for successful CR and weighted Lehmer mean for successful F
the paper's archive capacity is the population size and overflow deletion is random

primary_external_evidence.name: SHADE 1.1.1 C++ for CEC2014
primary_external_evidence.redistribution_rule: Do not vendor, copy or redistribute the source. Use only the public paper and independently specified behavior for a clean-room implementation unless permission or a license is obtained.
observed_version_specific_contract: fixed population size 100, memory size D, p-best rate 0.1 and archive capacity 2N in the shipped main configuration
normal CR and Cauchy F sampling
weighted Lehmer updates for both CR and F, which differs from the 2013 paper's CR arithmetic mean
r1 excludes only the target and r2 excludes target and r1; p-best is not excluded from those donor domains
the README states that 1.1.1 fixes an archive-update bug in 1.1.0

primary_external_evidence.title: An Efficient Constraint Handling Method for Genetic Algorithms
primary_external_evidence.journal: Computer Methods in Applied Mechanics and Engineering
primary_external_evidence.interpretation: Deb's rule is a separate constraint-handling layer; combining it with SHADE creates a project-defined composite unless an exact published algorithm and version are separately identified.

conformance_findings.finding: FR-SHADE is not bound to a verified publication, version, source hash or license and must not be presented as a standard external algorithm name.
conformance_findings.required_resolution: Select and freeze an explicit project composite identity and citation pair.

conformance_findings.finding: The current parent kernel is a pre-evaluated state-transition contract, not a complete SHADE optimizer: initialization, parameter sampling, p-best selection, mutation, crossover, evaluation and stopping loop are absent by design.
conformance_findings.required_resolution: Prepare and freeze additive full-parent red contracts before any complete optimizer implementation.

conformance_findings.finding: select_shade_donors excludes p-best from r1 and r2, while the inspected SHADE 1.1.1 reference implementation excludes r1 only from the target and r2 from target and r1.
conformance_findings.required_resolution: Either amend the frozen parent distinctness contract to the selected reference or rename and disclose the project-specific deviation; exact SHADE fallback cannot be claimed meanwhile.

conformance_findings.finding: The frozen parent contract and current kernel use deterministic oldest-first archive eviction, whereas the 2013 paper and inspected 1.1.1 source use random archive removal/replacement.
conformance_findings.required_resolution: Bind archive capacity and stochastic eviction to the selected parent identity and base_rng, or explicitly register a project deviation.

conformance_findings.finding: The current kernel applies weighted Lehmer means to both F and CR. This matches the inspected 1.1.1 source but not the 2013 paper, which specifies weighted arithmetic CR and weighted Lehmer F.
conformance_findings.required_resolution: The parent version decision must precede any claim of conformance.

conformance_findings.finding: The pre-evaluated ParentShadeState archives CandidateRecord objects but does not require retained vectors for archive members; a complete current-to-pbest/1 mutation cannot draw an archive vector from this state alone.
conformance_findings.required_resolution: Add an archive-vector invariant and red tests before full optimizer implementation.

conformance_findings.finding: The current comparator is a deterministic project extension of feasibility-first ordering because it adds objective and stable-ID tie breaks and allows an evaluator-supplied aggregate violation.
conformance_findings.required_resolution: Freeze the exact aggregate-violation normalization, equality tolerance and tie semantics as the project constraint layer.

conformance_findings.finding: No license text was observed in the author source archive.
conformance_findings.required_resolution: Use clean-room implementation from the frozen specification and papers; do not vendor the downloaded source without permission or a verified license.

scientific_consequence.current_test_status_interpretation: The 46 green contract tests demonstrate only the already frozen project contracts; they do not establish conformance to SHADE 2013, SHADE 1.1.1 or a published FR-SHADE algorithm.
scientific_consequence.next_safe_gate: Author selection of the parent identity, followed by a versioned additive parent-conformance specification and red-test amendment; no production change or optimizer execution.
